'''Ziugen''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Ziugen system/Legends|Ziugen system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']] that connected it to the world of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] and the [[Outland Transit Station]]. A smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route also linked Ziugen to the planet of [[Poytta]]. The inhabitants of Ziugen were equally devoted to industry and agriculture.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ziugen was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square T-12.<ref name="TEA" />
